title: R41-T025 Zoo Animals Decision-Tree Numeric Preprocessing Data Contract
description: Data contract for the eight-row synthetic pipeline-verification fixture. These synthetic rows are NOT observations from the UCI Zoo dataset and must NOT be cited as evidence of real-world or clinical performance.

record_id.description: Stable unique row identifier across the fixture (e.g. r1..r8).

group_id.description: Stable group identifier isolated across train/validation/test splits to prevent group leakage.

x1.description: Finite numeric synthetic feature taking values [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]; booleans and NaN/Inf are rejected.

x2.description: Finite constant numeric synthetic feature equal to 1 across all eight rows; exercises zero-variance scaling safety.

label.description: Binary integer class label in {0, 1}; booleans and out-of-set integers are rejected.

split.description: Fixed stratified partition assignment ensuring explicit train/validation/test separation.
